niche: Alternative Body Jewelry, Avant-Garde Apparel & Handcrafted Leather Goods
universe_description: Founded and directed by designer Bruno Laignel, Kaya Movement explores a biomechanical, sculptural aesthetic at the intersection of organic anatomy, sacred geometry, and futuristic cyberpunk architecture. Each artifact is sustainably realized using 3D computational modeling, lost-wax casting in 925 sterling silver and solid brass, and hand-finished full-grain leather.
